zeta.config.creatures.wolf_targets_skele: Untamed wolves consider skeleton horses valid prey.

Chance for a newly spawned untamed wolf to hunt players. 0 disables this feature.

zeta.config.creatures.passive_mobs_canno: Passive animals cannot board boats or minecarts.

zeta.config.creatures.fearless_cats.desc: Some naturally spawned cats no longer flee from players.

zeta.config.gameplay.name: Gameplay
zeta.config.gameplay.leash_any_mob.name: Leash Any Mob
zeta.config.gameplay.leash_any_mob.desc: Leashes can attach to any mob in survival mode. Villagers are controlled by the leash-villagers option instead.
zeta.config.gameplay.void_totem.name: Void Totem
zeta.config.gameplay.void_totem.desc: Held totems of undying save you from the void and teleport you to a safe landing spot nearby.
zeta.config.gameplay.guaranteed_zombie_v: Zombies always convert villagers into zombie villagers on any non-peaceful difficulty.
zeta.config.gameplay.mining_while_riding: Mining from a boat or minecart is as fast as mining on foot.
zeta.config.gameplay.rainbow_wool.name: Rainbow Wool
zeta.config.gameplay.rainbow_wool.desc: Shearing a sheep named jeb_ yields rainbow wool blocks that keep changing colours.
zeta.config.gameplay.flour.name: Flour
zeta.config.gameplay.flour.desc: Wheat can be ground into flour, and flour can be turned into slime balls.
Nine of any grass can be crafted into two green dye.
